accepted_sample_scopes: 10, 15 and20 µL operating volumes, five scans; this is measurement-solution volume, not CdS coating volume. ECL increased when running-solution volume rose from 10 to 15 µL and decreased slightly at 20 µL. The authors identify 15 µL as optimal for a thin-layer cell 1.10 cm long and 0.74 cm wide. At lower volume the solution did not cover the entire hydrophilic paper area. The authors propose that extra solution leaking outside the thin-layer electrochemical cell explains the change in ECL with increasing electrolyte volume. Leakage is a proposed explanation; its volume is not measured here.
